title: 受控水加热案例
setup: 使用已验证的水加热器模板及固定进料；本次授权求解。
expected_observations: 保存真实 SOLVED 日志、出口温度与指定值的偏差、外部衡算和输入指纹。
dependencies: 已审核温度和压力规格
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 泵增压案例
setup: 使用已验证单相液体泵模板和出口压力规格。
expected_observations: 比较出口压力与规格、流量守恒、效率和功率符号；数值容差需预先登记。
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 闪蒸相分配
setup: 运行已验证的二元闪蒸模板。
expected_observations: 核对组分与总质量平衡、相分率范围及独立相平衡参考。
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 回流流程
setup: 运行明确边界与初值的回流模板。
expected_observations: 内回流不重复纳入外部衡算；记录所有单元状态和迭代失败。
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 模板指纹变更
setup: 登记后修改模板副本，保留原登记。
expected_observations: 应拒绝不匹配模板，不提交伪造新结果。
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 组成不匹配
setup: 使用模板与项目组成不一致的案例。
expected_observations: 应报告不匹配，不在后台自动篡改多组分组成。
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 求解器返回错误
setup: 使用会失败的受控模板或明确的测试替身。
expected_observations: 错误如实保留；不标 SOLVED；测试替身与真实求解报告分开。
dependencies: 失败基准或明确标记的测试替身
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 运行中项目变化
setup: 求解期间更新项目修订号。
expected_observations: 旧结果不得覆盖新输入；应返回版本变化信息。
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 缺失经济参数
setup: 去掉价格、币种或基年中的必要项。
expected_observations: 只给缺失项，不输出猜测 CAPEX/NPV/IRR。
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 成本口径不一致
setup: 提供购买费用与安装投资口径不同的两条来源。
expected_observations: 区分成本边界；不能直接相加比较成最优结论。
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 独立验证
setup: 用归档值同时作预测与参考。
expected_observations: 标记同源性；不得声称完成独立数值验证。
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.

title: 缺少能量证据
setup: 只提供设备 duty 和质量流量。
expected_observations: 能量闭合保持未评估，并列出边界焓流等缺项。
dependencies: 求解输出或明确测试替身
tolerance_policy: Engineer must preregister units, reference values and acceptance tolerance where numeric checks apply.
